description: Massive rotational debris flow buried railway construction camp and blocked the Ijei river.
South Lhonak GLOF flash flood and debris slurry breached Teesta III dam.
Mud avalanche inundated railway station tracks and severed Lumding-Badarpur lifeline.
Deep-seated rotational slump along NH-29 disrupted trade logistics.
Multi-site failure triggered by Cyclone Remal rainfall on weathered Surma siltstones.
Continuous cloudburst caused slope liquidation across fragile Daling phyllite cuts.
High-velocity rockfall and scree slide along road cutting.
Siwalik sand-rock collapse after 36-hour intense rainfall.
